title: Domain property of strict henselization divisor quotient
statement: Let R be a commutative regular ring and f in R such that R/(f) is regular. Let Ω be an algebraically closed field and barY : Spec Ω → Spec R a geometric point. Let b : R → strictHenselizationRing barY induce the canonical strict henselization structural morphism on spectra. If b(f) is not a unit, then strictHenselizationRing barY/(b(f)) is a domain.

source.place: Tag 00NP (regular local rings are domains); local structure of the canonical strict henselization

proof.text: For the upstream full affine-neighbourhood colimit, use its proved local structure. The nonunit hypothesis makes the principal ideal proper by Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top. Its quotient is nontrivial by Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff and local by IsLocalRing.of_surjective'. The regularity component makes it regular, and IsRegularLocalRing.of_isRegularRing_of_isLocalRing makes it regular local. Apply the proved regular-local-domain instance. The retained small-colimit consumer identifies its quotient with this one by the canonical colimit comparison and Ideal.quotientEquiv.
